title: Managed Database: independent resource scopes
content:
## Governing clause
Managed Database independent resource scopes applies to database open. The signed resource scope is not already represented by a nonclosed contract. Multiple independent resource scopes may be held. Use external reference as the signed resource-scope key. Count all nonclosed holdings of this category for the same customer; refuse creation if the count would exceed maximum contracts per customer. A repeated signed application with the same external resource scope reuses the existing contract rather than opening another.

## Evidence: scope unique
The signed resource scope is not already represented by a nonclosed contract. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database contract reference, customer reference, status, external reference. The correlated evidence must refer together to database contract reference, customer reference. 

## Specific basis: maximum contracts per customer
Maximum contracts per customer: 24.
